scope: Repository hardening for DATA-02 current-fact refresh and four-Publication rebuild write paths.

failing_first_observations.limitation: Failing-first outputs were observed in the active terminal but were not redirected to a durable raw log; counts are recorded without reconstructing timestamps or output.

findings_resolved: The independent current-Publication rebuild path now requires exact current authority before its atomic transaction.
Both execute commands bind --operator to the server-issued actor and use that actor in created_by.
Long fact-refresh runs revalidate authority at provider and publication boundaries.
Quote and valuation batches prove exact returned asset identities, including duplicate/substitution rejection.
Expected configuration and authority failures are converted to stable CommandError output.

implemented_safeguards: A read-only Audit Application preflight composes the canonical runtime and validates exact current authority.
The Data Center reaches Audit only through the core integration facade; no Interface-to-Infrastructure or Application ORM dependency was added.
Fact refresh preflights before provider construction, repeatedly at write/provider boundaries, and immediately before final publication.
Quote and valuation results carry correlated asset identities; count-only success can no longer hide duplicate or substituted assets.
Four-Publication rebuild preflights authority before entering the transaction; preview remains read-only and authority-free.

governance.reason: Repository bypasses are closed, but genuine current authority, production audit activation, authorized provider backfill, financial source time, and four-Publication tolerance reconciliation are still absent.

remaining_gates: Deploy the reviewed candidate through an explicitly authorized production change.
Obtain genuine current service actor/account/tenant/owner authority and an active audited runtime selector.
After the completed China trading session, rerun the no-execute preview against the deployed candidate.
Execute only authorized bounded provider batches, preserving source observation and availability times and the governed 1% failover alert rule.
Reconcile quote, price, financial, and valuation Publications against the frozen denominator and obtain required owner acceptance.
